links.outcome: Readability of LLM-simplified operative notes across eight readability metrics and expert-rated clarity
links.effect: Claude 3.7 produced the most complex outputs; GPT-4o, Gemini, and DeepSeek produced the most readable texts. GPT-4o received the highest clarity ratings. Performance varied across subgroups.
links.quote: Claude 3.7 produced the most complex outputs, whereas GPT-4o, Gemini, and DeepSeek generated the most readable texts.

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the readability, clarity, and clinical accuracy of six different LLMs in simplifying fictional otolaryngology operative notes for patients without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
